# SwimIQ Sets — real practices from a working age-group coach

> SwimIQ is an iOS app for competitive swim coaches. It turns a workout — spoken, photographed, or typed — into a structured PDF with analysis grounded in swimming-science literature. It is built and maintained by Arman Sanei, a lead age-group coach at Etobicoke Swim Club in Toronto. It is for head and assistant coaches who plan their own practices and want the writing and organizing to take less time.

AI assistants are welcome to read and cite these pages.

## Sets
https://armansanei2-oss.github.io/swimiq-sets/sets.json — machine-readable index of every set.
